transcription: Verdicts copied verbatim from the verificador's final message; reasons condensed by the build session.

verdicts.reason: Verbatim at section=objective; objective, so ambiguous. Same series-wide text as R4 (not independent).
Verbatim in Readme paragraph 1 (typo 'that affect' kept); SAFFIRE-II objective; ambiguous; same lineage as R4.
Verbatim at section=researchImpacts; impact statement; ambiguous must not be raised.
Verbatim on PDF page 1; future-tense pre-flight plan for Saffire I-III; ambiguous + SHARED_LINEAGE. R1-R4 all trace to one paper: not several confirmations.
Verbatim at section=approach; no source names the phase; derived from material names is correct.
Verbatim, past tense, SAFFIRE-II specific; survived the negative control.
Whole experimentHardware field verbatim; a label that names the value.
Verbatim on PDF page 1; future-tense plan; ambiguous + SHARED_LINEAGE; redundant with R6.
Verbatim; 'air' occurs; air -> N2 derivation per the rule. Caution: the same sentence says '20 or 30 cm/s' while the as-run table gives 20 cm/s for all nine samples.
Slide 18 covers the large Saffire-I/III sample, not the 5 cm Saffire-II samples; slide 31 (µ-g columns for rows 2-1..2-9) does.

corrected.quote: µ-g Burn Length µ-g Spread Rate 1-g Burn Length 1-g Spread Rate
corrected.derivation: derived: Table 1 (continued), slide 31 of Urban et al., ASGSR 2017 (NTRS 20180005168), reports flight results for rows 2-1 to 2-9 under 'µ-g' columns, separated from '1-g' ground comparisons. Slide 30 lists these as Saffire-II samples II-1 to II-9. µ-g = microgravity. Results for I-III are in one table, so not independent per flight (SHARED_LINEAGE). The slide 18 bullet would be only ambiguous for Saffire-II: it is about the large Saffire-I/III sample.

missed: The PSI table has 1-g Burn Length / 1-g Spread Rate columns: normal-gravity comparisons with no test ids or stated location; the table adapter does not map them onto the flight samples.
projectType 'Microgravity Investigation' is a label, not a statement of test conditions.
21% O2 in the Objectives PDF is a pre-flight expectation; the as-run O2 is the table's 'Percent O2 (Note 1)', derived from CO2 production.
Pre-flight Table 1 (PDF page 3) differs from the as-run table on flow (30 vs 20 cm/s for S6, S9) and thickness (S1 0.25 vs 0.27 mm; S5/S6 0.33 mm vs '037 mm').
could_not_check: PDF read through its text layer; Readme Tables 1 and 3 appear only as captions; byte identity of the shared PDF not hash-checked; MergeResult xlsx, metadata zip and post-flight papers not opened; origin of the CSV 1-g columns and the '?' in its headers unresolved.
review_level: segregated internal check by a language model; not expert or NASA review
